alignments.note: Niphal with its auxiliaries, headed on the lexical verb; discontinuous around the negative under rule 25.
עֶבֶד with its licensed indefinite article.
כִּי rendered by the pair *For though*; both words belong to that one connective and the unit heads on the subordinating word, which realizes its own lexeme (rule 55).
The ASV writes no connective for this waw; counting the clause's conjunctions against its connectives leaves it unrendered (rule 14).
The existential negative takes the ASV's *not*; a negative morpheme standing in the clause carries the negation word (rules 48, 50).

The Hiphil participle takes its subject pronoun and auxiliary with the light-verb rendering *give heed*, headed on the complement (rules 17, 44); discontinuous around the negative. The margin's literal *answer* corroborates the identification without moving the unit.

review_notes: The competing reading gives *he will not* whole to the existential אֵין under rule 50; the participle was preferred as the morpheme carrying the clause's predication, leaving אֵין only the negation word.
